nodes.name: Mark start
nodes.notes: Remembers when this run began and what started it (for the run duration and trigger).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { idle: true, candidates: 0, n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id) } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.started', workflow_key: 'completion-detection', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: 'RUNNING', user_email: null, correlation_id: null }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.finished', workflow_key: 'completion-detection', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: $('Summarise').first().json.created > 0 ? 'WAITING' : 'SUCCESS', result: { candidates: $('Assess').first().json.candidates, matches: $('Assess').first().json.matches, proposals: $('Summarise').first().json.created }, error: null, duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - $('Mark start').first().json._t0) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.finished', workflow_key: 'completion-detection', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: 'SUCCESS', result: { candidates: $('Assess').first().json.candidates, matches: 0 }, error: null, duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - $('Mark start').first().json._t0) }) }}

meta.description: Proposes completing a commitment when a message says it is done.
